lib.image.damaged: Error when a picked image file is the right type but cannot be decoded.
lib.image.notAnImage: Error when a picked file is not an image at all; {types} is the list of accepted types, such as "PNG, JPEG or WebP".
lib.image.wrongType: Error when a picked file is an image of a type this slot does not take; {type} is what it is, {types} the accepted list.
